description.text: The three Starter Sets that opened the Sun & Moon series on 9 December 2016, the same day as its first expansions, Collection Sun and Collection Moon: Grass Decidueye-GX, Fire Incineroar-GX and Water Primarina-GX, led by the final evolutions of the Alola starters. Each held a 60-card deck with two copies of its Pokémon-GX, about half of its other cards random, so two copies of the same set differ a little, with a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book, a player's guide and the new GX marker, flipped when a player uses the one GX attack allowed in a game. This set holds the cards of all three.
